overall_vibe: Premium SaaS, smooth, lucrative, high-contrast, moody. Deep void black background with vibrant electric blue and purple gradients.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_first_rule: Always stack widgets on mobile, grid applied on md and up. Ensure max-h-[80vh] for any media on mobile.

components_strategy.cards: Cardless style with rectangular hard edges or very subtle rounded-xl. Flat background (#0D0D12), 1px solid border (white/6). On hover: border brightens to purple-500/30 with subtle inner glow.
components_strategy.buttons_primary: Vibrant gradient background (from-blue-500 to-purple-600). text-white font-medium. hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(139,92,246,0.4)] transition-all duration-300.
components_strategy.buttons_secondary: Transparent background with border-white/10 and text-white. hover:bg-white/5.
components_strategy.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn components but override default styling. bg-[#08080A], border-white/10, text-white. focus:border-purple-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500/50. Rounded-md.
components_strategy.tables_link_manager: Shadcn Table. Header bg-black/40 (backdrop-blur), text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500. Rows border-b border-white/5. Hover on row: bg-white/[0.02].
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use dark theme for charts. Line/Area charts with gradient fill under the curve (blue/purple). Tooltip MUST use glassmorphism: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border-white/10 text-white.
components_strategy.modals_dialogs: Glassmorphism backdrop: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60. Modal surface: bg-[#0D0D12] border border-white/10 shadow-2xl. p-6 rounded-xl.
components_strategy.sidebar_navigation: Collapsible sidebar for desktop, drawer for mobile. bg-[#030305] border-r border-white/5. Active link text-white bg-white/5 with a left accent border (purple-500). Inactive links text-zinc-400 hover:text-white.
components_strategy.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Override fixed h-9 to h-auto. bg-transparent border-b border-white/10. Active tab border-b-2 border-purple-500 text-white.

animations_and_motion.page_entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-up (y: 15, opacity: 0). Use for dashboard cards and table rows.
animations_and_motion.micro_interactions: Active states get a subtle scale (scale: 0.98 on tap). Loading states use a sleek skeleton pulse with bg-white/5.

icons.style: stroke-width 1.5. text-zinc-400 by default. Active/Primary icons text-purple-400 or gradient.

auth_background.description: Abstract dark blue and purple wavy 3D shapes. Use this as a full-screen background for the Auth (Login/Signup) page with a heavy overlay (bg-black/60 or backdrop-blur-md) so the login form is highly visible.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-purple-500
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-muted (#71717A or #A1A1AA) against background (#030305 or #0D0D12) meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over images without a backdrop blur or dark overlay.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='copy-link-button', data-testid='withdraw-action-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard fonts for Headings. Use 'Outfit'.
DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe component looks. Remove shadcn's default borders and apply the dark mode border-white/5 aesthetic.
DO NOT use dummyimage.com or via.placeholder.com. Use the Unsplash image provided for the auth page.
Build the 4 Top Analytics Cards using MODE B: CONTROL ROOM grid strategy. The metric value must be prominent (text-3xl font-semibold).
For the Chart.js / Recharts Monthly Analysis, use a vibrant primary gradient (blue to purple) for the line/bar, and ensure axes are legible on dark mode.
The Withdraw section should conditionally render input fields based on the selected method (UPI vs PayPal vs Crypto). Use Shadcn Select for the method dropdown.
Auth System: Build JWT/Google OAuth UI (frontend only).
Add 'Copy Link' feature with a toast notification (Sonner).
Ensure the sidebar navigation is fully responsive (hamburger menu on mobile).
